title: Designing an SSOT Publishing Pipeline
subtitle: Author once, syndicate everywhere — with canonical SEO done right
content_markdown:
# Designing an SSOT Publishing Pipeline

Write the article once, publish it to a primary home, then syndicate it to other platforms while pointing every copy's canonical URL back to the original.

## Why canonical URLs matter

Duplicate content across platforms dilutes SEO unless each copy declares its canonical source. This pipeline captures the primary URL once and injects it everywhere.
description: How to author an article once and syndicate it with correct canonical URLs.
